study: Cabell, Justice, Piasta et al. (2011), AJSLP 20(4):315-330 — preschool teacher responsivity education (adapted Hanen LLLI)
delivery_evidence: Genuine mix: in-person group workshops (3-day in-service, ~13 hr, held face-to-face in each geographical location) PLUS remote/off-site coaching in which teachers submitted videos and consultants provided written feedback throughout the year ('access to a consultant who provided off-site coaching'; 'view videos submitted... provide written feedback', p.319-320).
test_alignment_evidence: All extracted outcomes are broad standardized norm-referenced instruments (CELF Preschool-2 Grammar & Expressive Vocabulary, PPVT-III, Preschool Print & Word Awareness, PALS alphabet); none developer-made/proximal to the specific PD content (Tables 4-5, p.324-325; extraction test_type all standardized_independent).
curriculum_evidence: Intervention is conversational responsivity strategies (adapted from Hanen's Learning Language and Loving It), which 'requires no specialized classroom materials and can be readily integrated into any existing preschool curriculum'; vs business-as-usual (p.317).
outcome_timing_evidence: Outcomes measured in spring at the end of the academic year (~6-8 mo post-baseline), same year as the intervention; no delayed follow-up (timepoint 'spring', Tables 4-5).
